disposition_mapping.rationale: Cycle initiation and assumptions-pack issuance persist but are restructured around system-driven auto-population of mechanically refreshed macro/FX/corporate-target drivers, with the FP&A manager confirming and distributing rather than manually compiling.

Actuals collection and preparation persist but are restructured as a continuous automated ingestion feed with exception-based analyst intervention; period cutoff and subledger-lock discipline (reporting-period discipline principle) are preserved as mandatory automated checks rather than manual validation.

The mixed mechanical/judgment driver update function is split along its natural seam: mechanically refreshed drivers (FX, run-rates) move into the automated assumptions refresh at TS-01, while judgment-based drivers (volume, pricing, headcount) remain a distinct human-input step at TS-03, preserving explicit tracking of FX exchange differences rather than netting them.
Business unit submission remains a distinct, largely unchanged step; templates gain embedded validation to reduce downstream consolidation exceptions, but the function and actor are unchanged.

Consolidation and validation persist but are restructured to be system-automated with exception-based analyst review; the step still consumes closed-period actuals (validated baseline) as a mandatory input, satisfying FPA-R-02, and preserves policy-consistency requirements.
Variance analysis survives as a distinct step per FPA-R-01, with bridge/schedule generation automated but analyst-curated commentary and outlier investigation preserved.
Management review and approval survives unchanged in substance per FPA-R-03, remaining the gate before publication (FPA-R-04).
Forecast publication survives per FPA-R-05, unchanged in substance and sequenced strictly after approval (TS-07) per FPA-R-04.

steps.description: System-triggered initiation of the forecast cycle per the rolling cadence: mechanically refreshed macro indicators, corporate targets, FX rates and operational run-rate data auto-populate a draft assumptions pack. FP&A manager reviews and confirms the horizon/granularity, issues the assumptions pack and distributes timetable and templates to business units.
steps.name: Forecast cycle initiation and automated assumptions refresh
outputs: Assumptions pack issued (mechanically refreshed drivers pre-populated)

steps.description: Continuous system integration extracts closed-period actuals from GL and management reporting systems and maps them to forecast structure. Automated completeness and consistency checks enforce period cutoff and respect subledger locks (reporting-period discipline). Only flagged exceptions are routed to the FP&A analyst for resolution before the validated baseline is loaded to the forecast model.
steps.name: Automated actuals ingestion and cutoff validation
outputs: closed-period actuals (validated baseline) loaded to forecast model

steps.description: FP&A analyst works with operations and business unit leads to set the judgment-dependent driver assumptions (volume/demand outlook, pricing strategy, headcount plans, cost inflation) building on the mechanically refreshed drivers already issued in the assumptions pack. FX-related exchange differences are tracked explicitly and reported, not netted, per exchange-difference principles.
steps.name: Judgment-based driver assumption setting

steps.description: Business units prepare and submit forecast updates against the refreshed drivers using templates with embedded real-time validation rules (completeness, arithmetic and continuity checks) to reduce downstream consolidation exceptions; submissions include commentary on changes since the prior forecast.
steps.name: Business unit forecast submissions

steps.description: The forecast system automatically consolidates BU submissions together with the validated closed-period actuals baseline into the group forecast model, running automated checks for completeness, intercompany matching, headcount-to-cost coherence and continuity against actuals. Only flagged anomalies are routed to the FP&A analyst for investigation and correction, and computation methods are held consistent with prior periods or the change is surfaced.
steps.name: Automated consolidation and exception-based validation

steps.description: Automated generation of bridge analyses and risk/opportunity schedules comparing the consolidated forecast against budget and the prior forecast, quantifying movements by driver and business unit; FP&A analyst curates commentary and investigates material outliers.
steps.name: Variance analysis and bridge generation

steps.description: Present the consolidated forecast and variance analysis to management; challenge sessions on key assumptions; incorporate directed revisions; obtain approval of the forecast as the current planning baseline.
steps.name: Management review and approval

steps.description: Publish the approved forecast: update planning systems and reporting baselines, distribute the forecast pack and commentary to stakeholders, archive the version with its assumptions log.
steps.name: Publish forecast and reporting
